briefdescription.para: Collect an array of generic type parameters for this "formalizable" type.

detaileddescription.para: An already parameterized class is not formalizable. A type that has a explicit class identity is formalizable iff that class is parameterized. A relational type is formalizable if its both "legs" are formalizable and have identical generic type parameters.

simplesect.para: and a non-empty array if the type is formalizable; an empty array if the type doesn't have generic type parameters; or null if the type is not formalizable for any other reason

briefdescription.para: Find the type of the specified formal parameter for this type.

detaileddescription.para: Note, that this method is used to find a non-contradictory potential compile-time resolution rather than a guaranteed run time one.
For example: given a type: String[]? it's natural to decide at compile time that the type for the "Element" formal name is String. However, at run time the answer may differ.

the list of actual generic parameters
